title: Best-of-N inherits its grader
statement: Let a grader pick only among drafts passing the code checks, after showing on saved candidates that it tracks the real criterion and beats taking the first valid one.
example: Against a cheap ranker whose agreement with the true verdicts was no better than chance, picking the best of several drafts gave zero lift.
detail: A review of a proposed item factory settled by mechanism and code that best-of-N is argmax over the grader, so it inherits the grader's correlation to the truth and none of its own: measured, it gave zero lift against a cheap same-family ranker with kappa about 0, and converged only against a grounded oracle, which found a 0.94 pass in 2 candidates where 10 hand iterations had failed (`grade3-reading/artifacts/GOAL_grade3_hootl_convergence_2026_06_15.md`). The same record calls the cheap ranker a kappa~0 rubber stamp on subtle failures. A fact sheet found that an AP pipeline's 99% came from caching plus best-of-N, not from the generator (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/FACTS_SHEET.md`). Validating a grader before it picks among drafts includes checking whether its picks beat taking the first valid draft.
against: The item factory's evidence came from AP history items (`grade3-reading/artifacts/PROPOSAL_REVIEW_2026_06_16.md`), and a fact sheet rates the claimed convergence of the two efforts as weak, AP findings carried onto grade 3 rather than independent replication (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/FACTS_SHEET.md`). One small positive check for a model ranker, on a single pool of three items: "- Ranker picked index 0 (one of the tied-top items)" (`icloud-work/aptraining/Cheater/scripts/ranker/README.md`, line 111); no larger test of it was found. On another archive of 150 rows the selector picked a passing candidate on 137 of the 145 rows where one existed, a recall of 0.945 (icloud-work/aptraining-crystal-copy-20260521/variant-calibration-lab-snapshot/gemini_selector_calibration_final.md, line 15).

- Evidence: if bad candidates reach the selector, a fluent but invalid MCQ_SET can beat the actually passing raw candidate.
- Rule: deterministic filters come before Gemini. Gemini is a selector, not a rescue path.

Takeaway: Gemini did not beat first-valid on this archive. Do not enable Gemini as a selector for this policy from this evidence. It is audit-only until a larger saved-candidate calibration proves a lift.
- MCQ_SET: staged route; extra K only after filters, and selector must beat first-valid in calibration.
